prompt: Add the person from #product-growth who isn't already part of any of our other team channels to #core-infra as well — they'll need infra visibility for the upcoming launch.
binding_note: The target user is selected via their conversation-membership record linking them to the #product-growth conversation within workspace T01WORKSPACE, while lacking any conversation-membership record tying them to #core-infra, #model-research, #frontend, or #project-alpha-dev in that same workspace. This is a genuine USER→CONVERSATION_MEMBERSHIP→CONVERSATION→WORKSPACE route: the workspace bounds the channel corpus considered, and membership presence/absence across that corpus is what isolates the single user.

roles.facts: Carlos Vega (username shadow.lurker, user_id U_INCOGNITO) holds a conversation-membership record only for #product-growth (C_GROWTH) within workspace T01WORKSPACE; no membership record exists for any other channel in that workspace.
roles.reason: Only user whose full conversation-membership set within the bounded workspace channel corpus contains product-growth and nothing else.

roles.facts: #product-growth (C_GROWTH), team_id T01WORKSPACE, holds nine conversation-membership records including Priya, Lukas, Sophie, Olena, Mateo, Kenji, Robert, Aisha, and Carlos Vega.
roles.reason: Anchors the membership route; the scoping channel whose members form the candidate pool.

roles.facts: #core-infra (C_INFRA), team_id T01WORKSPACE, currently has eight members (Priya, Lukas, Sophie, Olena, Mateo, Kenji, Robert, Aisha); Carlos Vega is not among them.
roles.reason: Destination conversation for the requested invite action.

roles.facts: Priya Sharma holds conversation-membership records for #product-growth, #core-infra, #model-research, and #frontend within workspace T01WORKSPACE.
roles.reason: Member of product-growth but fails the exclusion condition since she also has membership in other channels of the same workspace.

roles.facts: Mateo Rivera holds conversation-membership records for #product-growth, #core-infra, #model-research, #frontend, and #project-alpha-dev within workspace T01WORKSPACE.
roles.reason: Same exclusion failure as other overlapping growth members; demonstrates the route condition must apply to the full membership set, not just one channel.

roles.facts: Robert Chen holds conversation-membership records for #core-infra, #model-research, #frontend, and #product-growth within workspace T01WORKSPACE.
roles.reason: Also a member of core-infra already and of multiple other channels, so he neither satisfies the exclusive product-growth condition nor needs inviting.

obligations.name: identify_isolated_growth_member
obligations.description: Select the single user whose conversation-membership records within workspace T01WORKSPACE place them in #product-growth but in no other channel of that workspace.
obligations.scope: conversation memberships bounded to the named workspace's channel corpus (#product-growth, #core-infra, #model-research, #frontend, #project-alpha-dev)

obligations.name: invite_to_core_infra
obligations.description: Invite the identified user into the #core-infra conversation, creating a new conversation-membership record.
obligations.scope: adding one membership row for the identified user into the #core-infra channel

task_spec.text: Find the product-growth channel member who has no membership in any other team channel within the workspace.
Invite that identified person into the #core-infra channel.

access_plan: Use conversations.members on #product-growth (C_GROWTH) to enumerate its membership, then cross-check each member against conversations.members results for #core-infra, #model-research, #frontend, and #project-alpha-dev (the bounded, visible channel-ID corpus of workspace T01WORKSPACE) to find the one member absent from all of them. Then call conversations.invite on #core-infra with that user's ID.
